body:
10.3 For backend connections, this might be excessive in L1, as MiTM attacks are not feasible in some environments such as cloud environments where you have a load balancer terminate the SSL connection and then forwarding it to servers behind it.  So I would suggest removing the backend connection requirement for L1

10.15 "Verify that only strong algorithms, ciphers, and protocols to provide both confidentiality and integrity." -> "Verify that only strong algorithms, ciphers, and protocols are used to provide both confidentiality and integrity."

comments.body:
10.17 seems like a slightly stronger wording of the old 10.16 and is listed as existing since 3.0, like the old 10.16. Is this numbering simply a typo or is there a reason for 10.16 being dropped and 10.17 being so similar?

Also, in the references TOFU is expanded as Time Of First Use, but the link (and way I've heard it used) expand it as Trust On First Use.

Edit: (I hope I understood correctly that this is the general issue for feedback on the v4 draft's chapter 10. Else I'll gladly open my own issue.)
We're leaving TLS everywhere as l1 for now. Also fixed renumbering 9675047
